title: Equity Brief — 21 Aug 2026
intro: Markets operate in a transitional regime with VIX at 15.48, showing cautious optimism as European and US indices post modest gains while digesting week-long losses. Session dynamics favor risk-on rotation with Russell 2000 outperforming (+0.73%) and defensive sectors lagging, though mega-cap tech displays mixed conviction amid consolidation.

sections.heading: 🌍 INDEX RANKING
sections.content:
IBEX 35 19,981 +0.86% — Spanish equities lead on banking strength and renewed infrastructure spending momentum
Russell 2000 3,014.26 +0.73% — Small-caps outperform on domestic growth optimism and relative valuation support
FTSE 100 10,819 +0.65% — UK index buoyed by energy and commodity exposures amid sterling stability
Dow Jones 53,090 +0.63% — Industrial heavyweights drive gains as rotation favors value over growth
DAX 26,129 +0.56% — German index recovers modestly but remains pressured by export concerns
Nikkei 225 66,016 -0.30% — Japanese equities weaken on profit-taking following recent breakout rally, down 4.63% weekly
🇺🇸 US MARKET
S&P 500 at 764.44 holds above 760 support with bullish bias if 768 resistance breaks; watch consumer confidence data Friday for directional catalyst.
Nasdaq 26,084 shows fatigue near 26,200 with tech leadership fragmenting; semiconductor earnings revisions driving near-term sentiment.
Dow 53,090 tests 53,400 weekly resistance supported by industrial orders rebound and energy sector strength.
🇪🇺 EUROPE
DAX 26,129 +0.56% reclaims 26,000 psychological level but needs sustained break above 26,300 to confirm reversal from weekly decline.
FTSE 100 10,819 +0.65% only major European index positive weekly, commodity linkage and defensive positioning attracting flows.
CAC 40 8,480 +0.32% stabilizes after luxury goods selloff but remains vulnerable below 8,550 resistance zone.
💻 TECH FOCUS
Tesla 350.80 +1.64% leads mega-cap tech on production expansion announcements and autonomous vehicle regulatory progress in California.
Meta 551.04 +0.95% recovers from weekly losses as AI monetization metrics improve and advertising demand stabilizes into Q3.

sections.heading: 🎯 TRADE IDEAS
sections.content:
LONG: Russell 2000 3,014 — domestic exposure benefits from dovish Fed positioning and valuation gap to large-caps — entry 3,010 — SL 2,985 — TP 3,065
LONG: Tesla 350.80 — momentum continuation with regulatory tailwinds and delivery beat potential — entry 348-352 — SL 338 — TP 375
SHORT/AVOID: Nvidia 216.14 — down
